name: .well-known
description: Auth0 Custom Extension that serves MCP OAuth protected-resource metadata.
author: mustafadeel

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && cd dist && zip -q package.zip index.js extension.js package.json
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs

MCP_RESOURCE_URL.description: Public MCP endpoint for which this extension serves OAuth metadata, for example https://tenant.region.webtask.run/auth0-forms-mcp/mcp.

AUTH0_TENANT_ORIGIN.description: Canonical Auth0 tenant issuer, for example https://tenant.us.auth0.com.

RESOURCE_NAME.description: Optional friendly name returned in protected-resource metadata.
